players.name: Lamar Jackson
players.note: On IR after right-thumb surgery, and the injury is likely season-ending. Baltimore traded for Jacoby Brissett as a replacement after rookie Joe Fagnano started the 33-10 TNF loss to Jacksonville on Nov. 5.

players.name: Jacoby Brissett
players.note: Sleeper's depth chart now has him as BAL's starting QB as of 7:48 AM PT Nov 7.

players.name: Kyler Murray
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (hamstring) as of 11:51 AM PT Nov 7. Earlier: Kevin O'Connell said Nov. 5 that Murray has a hamstring strain and is week to week, so Carson Wentz will start Monday night vs. Buffalo (Nov. 9). He is not headed to IR, but his starting job beyond this week is uncertain.

players.name: Carson Wentz
players.note: Named Minnesota's Week 9 starter for Monday night vs. Buffalo (Nov. 9) with Kyler Murray (hamstring) week to week, per Kevin O'Connell on Nov. 5. He won games over Green Bay and Chicago in relief earlier this season and could keep the job.

players.name: Joe Milton
players.note: Will make his first NFL start for the 2-6 Eagles vs. the Giants in Week 9, replacing benched Tanner McKee (reported Nov. 4). Jalen Hurts remains on IR with blood clots in his lungs, and Milton's rushing gives him streamer upside.

players.name: Sam Darnold
players.note: Ruled out for Week 9 vs. Arizona with a quad injury (ribs also listed), per Mike Macdonald on Nov. 4. He is week to week, and Drew Lock is set to start.

players.name: Jalen Milroe
players.note: Is the only backup to Drew Lock for Week 9 vs. Arizona with Sam Darnold out. Lock is still working back from a right elbow injury that cost him two games, so Milroe would make his first start if Lock can't go.

players.name: Deshaun Watson
players.note: Still in the concussion protocol as of Nov. 5, and his status for Sunday at New Orleans is unclear. Todd Monken said the game plan was built with Shedeur Sanders as the starter.

players.name: Shedeur Sanders
players.note: Expected to make his first start of the season Sunday (Nov. 8) at New Orleans with Deshaun Watson in the concussion protocol, after throwing just three passes this year. Todd Monken said the game plan was built around him, though Watson could still be cleared.

players.name: Gardner Minshew II
players.note: Named Arizona's starter moving forward and starts Week 9 at Seattle. Jacoby Brissett has been traded to Baltimore, leaving rookie Carson Beck as QB2.

players.name: J.J. McCarthy
players.note: Sleeper's depth chart has listed him as the Giants' starting QB since Nov. 4, with Jaxson Dart on IR. That makes him a starter going into Week 9 at Philadelphia.

players.name: Jaxson Dart
players.note: On IR, and Sleeper's depth chart has listed J.J. McCarthy as the Giants' starter since Nov. 4. Dart will not play Week 9.

players.name: Cam Skattebo
players.note: Skattebo (hamstring) is listed as doubtful for Sunday at Philadelphia (Nov. 8) after missing practice all week, including Wednesday and Thursday (Nov. 4-5).

players.name: Devin Singletary
players.note: With Cam Skattebo (hamstring) doubtful and Tyrone Tracy Jr. on IR, Singletary is expected to lead the Giants' backfield Sunday at Philadelphia (Nov. 8).

players.name: TreVeyon Henderson
players.note: Henderson (illness) is listed as out for Sunday vs. Green Bay (Nov. 8) and will miss a second straight game. He has not practiced since late October.

players.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
players.note: With TreVeyon Henderson (illness) listed as out for Sunday vs. Green Bay (Nov. 8), Stevenson should be New England's lead back again.

players.name: Kyle Monangai
players.note: Monangai (thumb/toe) is listed as questionable for Week 9 after missing Week 8 and not practicing Thursday (Nov. 5). He looks unlikely to have a big role even if he is active.

players.name: D'Andre Swift
players.note: With Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) questionable after missing practice Thursday (Nov. 5), Swift should lead Chicago again after his 27-carry, 3-TD game on Nov. 2.

players.name: Jonathan Taylor
players.note: Taylor had not been traded as of Nov. 6. The Colts are open to dealing him before the Nov. 10 deadline but want a big return, and the Vikings and Giants have been named as favorites, with the Broncos, Packers and Seahawks also interested.

players.name: Seth McGowan
players.note: Indianapolis remains open to trading Jonathan Taylor before the Nov. 10 deadline. A deal would make McGowan the Colts' lead back.

players.name: Tony Pollard
players.note: Multiple teams have shown interest in Pollard ahead of the Nov. 10 deadline, per Mike Florio. He played 82% of the snaps in Week 8 with Tyjae Spears (knee) out, and Spears is out again for Week 9.

players.name: Tyjae Spears
players.note: Spears (knee) is listed as out for Week 9 after also missing Week 8 (Nov. 1). No return timeline has been reported.

players.name: David Montgomery
players.note: Montgomery (groin) has been ruled out for Week 9 at the Chargers (Nov. 8) and will miss a third straight game.

players.name: Woody Marks
players.note: With David Montgomery (groin) ruled out, Marks will lead Houston's backfield again Sunday at the Chargers (Nov. 8).

players.name: Jonah Coleman
players.note: Coleman out-snapped J.K. Dobbins 40-14 on Nov. 1 and is Denver's lead back while RJ Harvey (knee) is on IR. Denver has also been linked to Jonathan Taylor before the Nov. 10 deadline, which could change that.

players.name: J.K. Dobbins
players.note: Dobbins played only 14 snaps to Jonah Coleman's 40 on Nov. 1 and has lost Denver's lead role.

players.name: RJ Harvey
players.note: Harvey (knee) has been on short-term IR since Oct. 31. Jonah Coleman's breakout, and Denver's reported interest in Jonathan Taylor, threaten his role when he returns.

players.name: Jeremiyah Love
players.note: Arizona placed Love (high ankle sprain) on IR on Nov. 3, and he is expected to miss 4-5 weeks.

players.name: Tyler Allgeier
players.note: With Jeremiyah Love on IR (placed Nov. 3) and Zonovan Knight (concussion) listed as out, Allgeier should handle a heavy workload for Arizona in Week 9.

players.name: Zonovan Knight
players.note: Knight (concussion) is listed as out for Week 9 after failing to clear the protocol, as of Nov. 6.

players.name: Ashton Jeanty
players.note: Klint Kubiak said Nov. 4 that the Jeanty/Mike Washington Jr. split will be set week to week. After Jeanty had just 2 carries in Week 8, he projects mostly as the passing-down back at San Francisco.

players.name: Mike Washington Jr.
players.note: Washington took 25 carries for 83 yards as the Week 8 starter (Nov. 1) and is the early-down favorite for Week 9 at San Francisco, given Kubiak's week-to-week comments on Nov. 4.

players.name: Ollie Gordon II
players.note: Gordon played 80% of the snaps for a second straight week on Nov. 1 and is Miami's clear lead back while De'Von Achane is on IR.

players.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
players.note: Sleeper now lists him on injured reserve (hamstring) as of 1:46 PM PT Nov 7. Earlier: Robinson (hamstring) is listed as out for Week 9 and will miss a third straight game.

players.name: Braelon Allen
players.note: Breece Hall (quad) is off the injury report and expected to return Sunday vs. Kansas City (Nov. 8). Aaron Glenn said 'both guys will play,' which cuts into Allen's lead role.

players.name: Breece Hall
players.note: Hall (quad) is off the injury report and expected to return Sunday vs. Kansas City (Nov. 8) after five straight inactive games. Aaron Glenn said both Hall and Braelon Allen will play.

players.name: Derrick Henry
players.note: Henry managed 57 yards in the 33-10 TNF loss to Jacksonville on Nov. 5, with third-string QB Joe Fagnano starting and Lamar Jackson on IR. Expect stacked boxes until Jacoby Brissett takes over in Week 10.

players.name: Jonathon Brooks
players.note: The Panthers are not opening Brooks' (core muscle) practice window yet, per CBS. He stays on IR with no return in sight.

players.name: Omarion Hampton
players.note: Hampton is the listed starter for Sunday vs. Houston (Nov. 8), and Yahoo reports he is expected to get more touches after four straight games of 45 or fewer rushing yards in a three-back committee.

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.note: Ruled out for Week 9 vs. Green Bay on New England's final injury report (Nov 6), listed with ankle and neck injuries after missing every practice this week.

players.name: DeMario Douglas
players.note: With A.J. Brown ruled out (Nov 6) and Romeo Doubs on IR, Douglas projects as one of New England's top targets vs. Green Bay on Sunday.

players.name: Garrett Wilson
players.note: Ruled out (concussion) for Sunday's game at Kansas City on the Jets' final Week 9 report (Nov 6). He has been in the protocol since Nov 4.

players.name: Adonai Mitchell
players.note: With Garrett Wilson ruled out (concussion) on Nov 6, Mitchell (7-142-1 in Week 8) leads the Jets' receivers at Kansas City and is one of the top waiver adds of the week.

players.name: Antonio Williams
players.note: With Terry McLaurin out for the season, Williams led Washington in routes, targets and catches in the Nov 1 win over Philadelphia. He is a top Week 9 waiver target and the Commanders' WR2 behind Stefon Diggs.

players.name: Carnell Tate
players.note: Tate (shoulder) missed Week 8, and Tennessee is on bye in Week 9. He is expected back for Week 10 vs. Jacksonville on Nov 15.

players.name: DeVonta Smith
players.note: Ruled out (hamstring) for Week 9 vs. the Giants (Nov 6), his third straight missed game.

players.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
players.note: Ruled out (hamstring) on San Francisco's final Week 9 report (Nov 6) for Sunday vs. Las Vegas, along with Mike Evans and Christian Kirk.

players.name: Demarcus Robinson
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 2:47 PM PT Nov 7.

players.name: Brandon Aiyuk
players.note: Aiyuk has hired a new agent to push for his exit from San Francisco, and ESPN says Washington hasn't fully dropped the idea of trading for him before the Nov 10 deadline.

players.name: Amon-Ra St. Brown
players.note: Listed questionable (ribs) for Sunday at Miami after limited practices all week, but reports as of Nov 6 say he is expected to play.

players.name: George Pickens
players.note: Questionable (hamstring) and a game-time decision for Sunday at Indianapolis after three limited practices. Brian Schottenheimer said Nov 6 he is hopeful Pickens will play.

players.name: Emeka Egbuka
players.note: Listed questionable (foot) for Week 9 vs. Chicago despite full practices Thursday and Friday (Nov 5-6). Todd Bowles calls him a game-time decision after he missed the past two games.

players.name: DJ Moore
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 11:51 AM PT Nov 7. Earlier: Moore was limited in practice Thursday (Nov 5) and is questionable. Buffalo plays Monday night at Minnesota, which gives him an extra day.

players.name: Brenen Thompson
players.note: Thompson (quad) has been listed doubtful for Week 9 since Nov 4 after missing Week 8. It is the same quad problem that cost him Weeks 3-5.

players.name: Brian Thomas Jr.
players.note: Thomas played only 34% of snaps and drew zero targets in the Nov 5 TNF win at Baltimore. Kansas City is reported to be in the receiver market and is linked to him before the Nov 10 deadline.

players.name: Jakobi Meyers
players.note: Meyers led Jacksonville with 4 catches for 65 yards on 6 targets in the Nov 5 TNF win at Baltimore, while Brian Thomas Jr. was shut out.

players.name: Jauan Jennings
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (calf) as of 11:51 AM PT Nov 7. Earlier: Jennings was listed questionable with a calf injury as of Nov 5, and Sleeper now lists him with Minnesota. His Week 9 availability and role in the new offense are unclear.

players.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
players.note: With Lamar Jackson on IR, rookie QB Joe Fagnano threw for 60 yards and two interceptions in the Nov 5 TNF loss to Jacksonville. Baltimore reportedly traded for Jacoby Brissett, but its passing outlook stays poor.

players.name: Elijah Sarratt
players.note: Sarratt was a healthy inactive for the Nov 5 TNF loss to Jacksonville. Baltimore's offense is down to rookie Joe Fagnano or newly acquired Jacoby Brissett at QB.

players.name: Germie Bernard
players.note: Bernard is Pittsburgh's WR2 with Michael Pittman Jr. on IR, but the Steelers are on bye in Week 9 and are reported to be in the receiver trade market before the Nov 10 deadline.

players.name: Davante Adams
players.note: Adams remains on IR with a ruptured hamstring on a 6-10 week timeline from Sean McVay. CBS projects a return around Week 12.

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.note: Pierce remains on IR with a heel injury, and as of Nov 5 Indianapolis had not opened his 21-day practice window.

players.name: Jayden Higgins
players.note: Higgins is on IR with a season-ending ACL injury, and Houston's trade for Marvin Harrison Jr. this week crowds his future role.

players.name: Malik Nabers
players.note: Nabers (knee) missed Thursday's practice but was a full participant Friday, Nov 6, and carries no injury designation for Week 9 at Philadelphia. Coach Harbaugh said he'll be 'full-go for the game.'

players.name: Mike Evans
players.note: The 49ers officially ruled Evans (ribs/Achilles) out for Week 9 vs. the Raiders on Nov 6, along with Christian Kirk and Deebo Samuel.

players.name: Rashid Shaheed
players.note: Shaheed (knee) is out for Week 9 as of Nov 6 after not practicing Thursday, so he will miss a second straight game.

players.name: Jordyn Tyson
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (hamstring) as of 1:46 PM PT Nov 7. Earlier: Tyson (hamstring) practiced on a limited basis this week after being designated to return from IR and was considered questionable to debut Sunday vs. Cleveland. As of Nov 6 there was no confirmed activation.

players.name: Ted Hurst III
players.note: Emeka Egbuka (foot) is questionable for Tampa Bay's Week 9 game vs. Chicago (Nov 6 report), even though he practiced fully Thursday and Friday. If Egbuka sits, Hurst is in line for more targets.

players.name: Keon Coleman
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 11:51 AM PT Nov 7. Earlier: Coleman (shoulder) was limited in practice Nov 5. Buffalo plays Monday at Minnesota, so his final designation will come later than other teams'.

players.name: Michael Wilson
players.note: Wilson is off the injury report as of Nov 6 and is expected to play through broken ribs. With Kendrick Bourne on IR (Nov 3), more targets should come his way.

players.name: Rashee Rice
players.note: Rice (hamstring/knee) practiced fully on Nov 5 and is on track to play vs. the Jets in Week 9.

players.name: Xavier Worthy
players.note: Rice is back to full practice (Nov 5), and Kansas City is widely expected to add a receiver before the Nov 10 deadline. Either would push Worthy down the target pecking order.

players.name: Tyreek Hill
players.note: Hill is still a free agent. Recent reports say he is 'not healthy enough,' and a civil jury found him liable on two domestic-violence-related counts. A Chiefs reunion looks unlikely.

players.name: Josh Downs
players.note: Downs requested a trade from the 2-5 Colts (reported Oct 28), and Indianapolis has fielded offers from multiple teams. No deal had been reported as of Nov 6, ahead of the Nov 10 deadline.

players.name: Zachariah Branch
players.note: Branch (hamstring) missed Week 8 and is listed out for Week 9, with no practice participation reported this week.

players.name: Zay Flowers
players.note: Flowers had 3 catches for 6 yards in the 33-10 TNF loss to Jacksonville on Nov 5, with rookie Joe Fagnano at QB. Lamar Jackson is on IR, so the Ravens' passing outlook is poor.

players.name: Romeo Doubs
players.note: Doubs (shoulder) has been on IR since Oct 19 and is out at least through Week 10.

players.name: Terry McLaurin
players.note: McLaurin tore his left patellar tendon on Oct 19 and is out for the 2026 season.

players.name: Hunter Henry
players.note: Henry (foot) sat out Wednesday and Thursday practices, then returned as a limited participant Friday, Nov 6, and is officially questionable for Sunday vs. Green Bay. Reports conflict on whether he will play, so check inactives before kickoff.

players.name: Eli Raridon
players.note: Hunter Henry (foot) got in a limited practice Friday, Nov 6, and is questionable rather than ruled out for Week 9 vs. Green Bay. Raridon (92% of snaps in Week 8) would lead New England's TEs if Henry sits, but his upside now hinges on Sunday's inactives.

players.name: Jake Ferguson
players.note: Ferguson (low-ankle sprain) returned to practice as a limited participant Friday, Nov 6, and is questionable for Sunday at Indianapolis; ESPN calls him no better than 50/50. Brevyn Spann-Ford would lead the TEs if he sits.

players.name: Terrance Ferguson
players.note: Ferguson, still on IR with an ankle injury, hurt his hamstring in Friday's Nov 6 practice and was ruled out for Sunday at Washington, even though Sean McVay had expected him to play. His 21-day window runs through late November, and Week 10 is his next possible return.

players.name: Mark Andrews
players.note: Baltimore lost 33-10 to Jacksonville on TNF (Nov 5) as third-string QB Joe Fagnano threw for just 60 yards. The Ravens' next game is Nov 16 vs. the Chargers, with newly acquired Jacoby Brissett expected to start.

players.name: Chris Rodriguez Jr.
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:01 PM PT Nov 4. Earlier: Rodriguez (hand) was limited at practice Tuesday (Nov. 3). He would be the top candidate to lead Jacksonville's backfield Thursday at Baltimore if Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot, DNP twice) sits.

players.name: Dalton Kincaid
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 2:52 PM PT Nov 6. Earlier: Kincaid (chest) is listed as questionable on Sleeper as of Nov 5. He was limited with the same chest injury in late October practices.

players.name: MarShawn Lloyd
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (knee) as of 1:56 PM PT Nov 5.

players.name: Jaylen Wright
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (quadriceps) as of 1:57 PM PT Nov 4.

players.name: Bhayshul Tuten
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 5:22 PM PT Nov 5. Earlier: Tuten (ankle/foot) did not practice all week and is officially questionable for TNF at Baltimore tonight (Nov. 5). Liam Coen calls him a game-time decision, though Coen said Tuten told him he feels better.

players.name: Harold Fannin Jr.
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 11:58 AM PT Nov 6. Earlier: Fannin (groin) is listed as questionable on Sleeper as of Nov 5. He had offseason groin surgery, so the injury is worth watching ahead of Sunday.

players.name: Denzel Boston
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 11:58 AM PT Nov 6. Earlier: Boston (calf) was limited in Wednesday's practice (Nov 4) before Cleveland's Week 9 game at New Orleans. His game status is unresolved.

players.name: Demond Claiborne
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (knee) as of 11:51 AM PT Nov 7.

players.name: Kaytron Allen
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (quadriceps) as of 1:57 PM PT Nov 4.

players.name: Travis Kelce
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:56 PM PT Nov 5. Earlier: Kelce (ankle) was limited in Wednesday's Nov 4 practice, which reports view as likely maintenance. He played through it in Week 8 (5-67 on 7 targets) and has two more chances to practice fully before Sunday vs. the Jets.

players.name: Christian McCaffrey
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 2:52 PM PT Nov 6. Earlier: McCaffrey (hamstring) returned to practice as a limited participant Thursday (Nov. 5) after sitting out Wednesday, and reporters expect him to play Sunday vs. Las Vegas. Friday's report will give his final designation.

players.name: Alvin Kamara
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 12:55 PM PT Nov 6. Earlier: Kamara's Week 9 listing was for rest (not injury related) on the Nov. 4 report, so there's little concern for Sunday.

players.name: Matthew Stafford
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 5:19 PM PT Nov 4. Earlier: Stafford is dealing with an arm injury, and Sean McVay said he will defer to Stafford on how he feels ahead of Sunday. The Rams' first Week 9 injury report comes Wednesday, Nov. 4.

players.name: Saquon Barkley
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:51 PM PT Nov 6. Earlier: Barkley (hamstring/back) practiced Thursday (Nov. 5) after missing Wednesday, and he looks on track to play Sunday vs. the Giants.

players.name: Kenny Gainwell
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 12:58 PM PT Nov 5. Earlier: Gainwell is listed as questionable (hip) for Week 9 as of Nov. 4, after splitting snaps 30-30 with Bucky Irving on Nov. 1.

players.name: Christian Watson
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 12:55 PM PT Nov 6. Earlier: Watson (ribs) was limited again Thursday (Nov 5) but practiced in pads. Reports say signs point to him playing Sunday vs. New England.

players.name: Dontayvion Wicks
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (ankle) as of 1:51 PM PT Nov 6.

players.name: Jack Strand
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (coach's decision) as of 5:57 AM PT Nov 8.
